_comment: EXAMPLE probe manifest for tools/teacher_probe.py — the image paths
below are POD-SIDE paths (/tmp/t_*.png), the probe screenshots used
live on the pod during the constant-'true' teacher incident. They do
not exist on a dev machine: copy this file, point 'image' at real
screenshots (or use --fake with canned responses) before running.
Positives show a wooden trunk in view; negatives show only sky or
only canopy — the contrast the teacher must discriminate to PASS.

questions.prompt: You are shown a first-person screenshot from a 3D outdoor environment. Question: is the vertical wooden trunk of a tree visible anywhere in this image? Look for a column with bark texture; leaves alone or empty sky alone do not count. Respond with strict JSON only, exactly one of: {"answer": true} or {"answer": false}. No other text.
